title: U.S. Marines Rescue French Simulated Downed Pilot
description: U.S. Marines with Special-Purpose Marine Air-Ground Task Force Crisis Response-Africa extract a notional French downed pilot during a tactical recovery of aircraft and personnel exercise, Dec. 7 near Albacete, Spain. TRAP exercise was a part of a month-long Tactical Leadership Programme Flying Course, designed to train fighter jet pilots from 10 NATO countries in a multinational environment. (U.S. Marine Corps Motion Imagery by Staff Sgt. Vitaliy Rusavskiy/Released)
